records.public_safe_text: unit 1 was traveling southbound in the [roadway]; the operator, hunter, james, reported that he suddenly saw an unknown dark object/[roadway] in front of him. hunter advised that he immediately apply the brakes with the intent to stop his vehicle (unit 1). hunter advised that because it was raining and the roadway was wet he was unable to stop before hitting the unknown object which went over the hood of his vehicle and then hit his front windshield before landing on the ground. hunter reported that he turned around to check on what he hit and he went onto say that since it was dark and raining he didn't really know what he struck. it was then when he found out that he struck a person/pedestrian (sides, travis lynn). hunter immediately called 911 for assistance. hunter presented valid proof of insurance but appeared to have a suspended/invalid drivers license (citation issued). hunter's vehicle sustained moderate damage to the front end (right side) and front windshield. upon officer's arrival; a white male, later identified as sides, travis lynn (victim/pedestrian) was seen lying in the grassy area (west side of roadway); he was complaining of pain in his left shoulder. a white female, later identified as jones, melody, was in victim sides proximity and reported to be his girlfriend. jones stated that they were walking southbound and admitted being in the roadway ([roadway]) at the time of the accident. no sidewalk is available in the west of side of the roadway ([roadway].) however; there is a sidewalk available for pedestrians in the east side of the roadway. victim [medical facility] by desoto [identifier].
